figures.caption: Reversed-phase HPLC on a semipreparative Vydac C-18 column of pooled skin secretions from B. boans collected in Trinidad after partial purification on Sep-Pak C-18 cartridges. figures.caption: A comparison of the primary structure of figainin 2BN peptides from B. boans with the corresponding peptide from B. raniceps and the primary structures of picturin 1BN and picturin 2BN peptides from B. boans with the corresponding peptides from B. picturata. The primary structure of tryptophylin BN from B. boans is compared with those of similar peptides from Litoria dentata. Strongly conserved residues are shown in red. a denotes C-terminal α-amidation. A gap denoted by * is included to maximize structural similarity.
figures.label: Figure 5
